pokemon_scp.name: Bulbasaur
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0001 is to be contained in a reinforced terrarium with automated humidity control. Personnel must wear protective eyewear due to SCP-0001’s ability to emit concentrated photonic bursts.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0001 resembles a small quadrupedal reptile with a plant-like growth on its back. The organism can generate bioluminescent energy capable of stunning or blinding targets.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Generally docile but becomes aggressive when the plant bulb is touched.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0001-A: SCP-0001 appears to photosynthesize emotional states, becoming more luminous around excited personnel.
